title: Sub-national crop calendar (planting & harvest month windows), Kenya
source: JRC ASAP — Anomaly Hotspots of Agricultural Production, sub-national crop calendar
license: JRC open data (European Commission reuse policy, Decision 2011/833/EU)
method: Deterministic CSV parse (_sources/parse_seasonal_calendar.py). No LLM/transcription: dekad (36/yr) -> month arithmetic, wrapped harvest windows split into contiguous month segments. Joined to the canonical 47 counties via county_key.parquet; ASAP short names Keiyo-Marakwet/Tharaka aliased to Elgeyo Marakwet/Tharaka Nithi; 'Malindi' dropped (inside Kilifi county, which ASAP carries separately) and 'Unit unavailable' dropped.
grain: county x crop x season x stage -> one row per contiguous month segment

columns.gaul1_code: GAUL24 admin1 code (matches CHIRPS gaul1_code / shared topojson)
columns.m_start: first calendar month of the segment (1-12)
columns.m_end: last calendar month of the segment (1-12)

coverage: 38 of 47 counties. The 9 without an ASAP crop calendar are the 8 arid/semi-arid pastoralist counties (Garissa, Isiolo, Mandera, Marsabit, Samburu, Tana River, Turkana, Wajir) plus Mombasa (urban). This is an honest gap, not missing data: those economies have no rainfed crop season — their seasonality is the rains themselves (CHIRPS, Block 2) and pasture greenness (NDVI, forthcoming task #11).
used_by: notebook.qmd Block 2 (per-county planting/harvest strip; grounds the OND/MAM season windows and the Block 3 harvest lag)
